title: Voynich EVA words
description: One row per word of the EVA lines (roadmap item 2.6), cut by the EVA tokenizer (vcat/words.py), with its position in its line and in the source's paragraph and its line's hand, Currier language, section and quire.

word_id.description: The word's id: its line's `line_id`, a period and its position in the line (`f1r:1.3`)

line_id.description: The line (locus) it is in, as in the lines config

line_index.description: The line's position on its page, as in the lines config

word_index.description: The word's position in its line, from 1

word.description: The word: a run of the line's `text_clean` between word spaces (`vcat/words.py`)

space_after.description: The space after it: `certain` (`.`), `uncertain` (`,`), or null for the last word of the line

line_initial.description: Whether it is the first word of its line

line_final.description: Whether it is the last word of its line

paragraph_id.description: The source's paragraph it is in (`<page>.p<n>`, the n-th on the page), or null outside every paragraph

line_in_paragraph.description: Its line's position in the paragraph, from 1; null outside one

paragraph_initial.description: Whether it is the first word of its paragraph

paragraph_final.description: Whether it is the last word of its paragraph

line_type.description: The line's type, as in the lines config (`paragraph`, `label`, `circle`, `radius`)

locus_type.description: The line's IVTFF locus code, as in the lines config (`@P0`)

hand.description: The line's hand (`$H`), as in the lines config

currier_language.description: The line's Currier language (`$L`), as in the lines config

section.description: The line's section, as in the lines config

quire.description: The line's quire (`$Q`), as in the lines config
